raw_candidates.title: Cluster frontmatter regression via stale plugin cache
raw_candidates.body: 32 cluster files regressed to broken YAML despite NOTE-012 fix. Root: Local Marketplace Subproject plugin was cached with stale add_cluster.py (missing json.dumps() quoting). Lesson: file-generation templates in cached dependencies can drift undetected; immediate file validation after write catches this.

raw_candidates.title: Repair file corruption by re-rendering from DB
raw_candidates.body: For files with a DB source-of-truth (atoms.db), repair corruption by re-rendering entire file from DB row via canonical write function, not hand-editing. Preserves all fields, avoids alignment drift, creates audit trail. Pattern: validate_clusters.py::fix_from_db().

raw_candidates.title: Self-check validation after every file write
raw_candidates.body: Wire validation to run immediately after file writes (sync, before return). Raises loudly on schema/parse errors, preventing broken output from shipping silently. Catches template regressions immediately. Most effective if all writes funnel through a single function.

raw_candidates.title: Vault corruption: orphans vs broken frontmatter
raw_candidates.body: Two distinct vault corruption modes: orphaned files (exist on disk, no atoms.db row; don't repair—can't reconstruct safely) vs broken frontmatter (malformed YAML; repair from DB). Different remediation prevents data loss. Applied: 32 broken files fixed; 15 pre-existing orphans flagged but untouched.

vcc_untuned_candidates.title: Re-render from source, never patch generated output
vcc_untuned_candidates.body: When generated data (config, YAML, etc.) is found broken, fix the generator and re-render from the source of truth, don't manually edit the output. Applied here: atoms.db is cluster frontmatter source of truth; fix_from_db() re-renders from DB rows using template logic, never patches YAML text directly.

vcc_untuned_candidates.title: Stale plugin cache caused template regression
vcc_untuned_candidates.body: Plugin held in-memory stale copy of add_cluster.py's _render_file, missing json.dumps()-wrap on unique field. Caused 32 cluster files to ship with broken frontmatter. Same bug class as note-012. Risk: plugin caches persist across edits; invalidate cache after template changes.

vcc_untuned_candidates.title: Self-check cluster writes for frontmatter validity
vcc_untuned_candidates.body: Wired validate_clusters.fix() into write_cluster() so every cluster render immediately self-validates and raises if broken. Catches template regressions on write, prevents silent shipping. All cluster creation paths (CLI, convergence-extractor, /cluster-atoms) funnel through write_cluster, so validation covers everything.

vcc_untuned_candidates.title: Orphan cluster files lack atoms.db backing
vcc_untuned_candidates.body: 15 cluster .md files exist with no matching atoms.db row (pre-existing gap unrelated to frontmatter bug). Cannot be re-rendered from source; separate handling required. find_orphans() reports but does not touch these files.

vcc_v2_candidates.title: Validate cluster frontmatter on every write
vcc_v2_candidates.body: Wired automated frontmatter validation into add_cluster.py's write_cluster(). Every cluster write self-validates and raises if invalid. Catches regressions immediately since all cluster creation paths (CLI, convergence-extractor, /cluster-atoms) funnel through this function.

vcc_v2_candidates.title: Repair broken cluster YAML via DB re-render
vcc_v2_candidates.body: Broken frontmatter repaired by re-rendering from atoms.db (canonical source) using existing _render_file template. Centralizes rendering logic and prevents manual edit errors. Never hand-patch YAML text.

vcc_v2_candidates.title: Orphan cluster files are separate audit gap
vcc_v2_candidates.body: Some cluster .md files have no atoms.db row (pre-existing orphans, unrelated to frontmatter corruption). Validator flags these separately and leaves untouched—distinct audit issue. Future cleanups should address these separately.

vcc_v2_candidates.title: validate_clusters tool has check and repair modes
vcc_v2_candidates.body: CLI supports --check flag for read-only audit (exits 1 if broken, suitable for CI gates). Default mode repairs in-place and reports results.
